source_records.title: Bi2Se3 topological insulator
source_records.author: Synopsys QuantumATK
source_records.detail: Tutorial version 2016.2, Build the Bi2Se3 crystal: hexagonal a=4.138, c=28.64 angstrom; Se 3a (0,0,0), Bi 6c z=0.399, Se 6c z=0.206. Reconstructed hexagonal cell then converted to primitive cell.

construction: Reconstructed from cited parameters; no energy/force optimization performed.
verification: CIF and POSCAR reread: atom count, symmetry, metric tensor, MIC distances passed; spglib primitive count verified.
